title: Email to Doty about who wrote Serpo

tellings.quote: Dodie said, "I tip my hat off to you for realizing there was more people involved."

plain: A researcher named Deep Prasad says that in 2020 he emailed Richard Doty, a former Air Force counterintelligence agent, about who had really written Project Serpo, a widely shared story about a supposed secret exchange of people with an alien world. Prasad had concluded more than one person was behind it, and he says Doty wrote back, "I tip my hat off to you for realizing there was more people involved," which would mean the story was a group effort.
